counterparts_needing_dossiers.name: Catalan Duchies of Athens and Neopatras

problems: Cliopatria row 'Taifa of Córdoba' does not match its article (1031-1091); its 1241-1249 shape holds Jaén and may be a fragment of the Emirate of Granada. The 1236 shape is one cell outside Córdoba. Consider relabelling or dropping.
Cliopatria 'Taifa of Tejada' shape lies on the eastern Algarve near Faro, not at Tejada in Huelva; replaced by a 27 km circle (a reading).

Cliopatria 'County of Berga' row holds Cerdanya (from 1169) and Roussillon (from 1188), which the Alfonso II and Roussillon pages put with the Crown 1168/1172-1209; the county-of-berga dossier dates a loss to the Crown in 1199 and a gain in 1209, which disagrees with the Crown's 1168/1172 gains. Reviewer should reconcile.

The kingdom-of-aragon dossier (another eu-12 part) must end in 1162, because the Crown dossier carries the Kingdom of Aragon and County of Barcelona land from 1163 (new keyframe crown-of-aragon_1163); otherwise the land is drawn twice.
Cliopatria's Crown shapes carry cells in central Greece that belong to the Catalan duchies of Athens and Neopatras; a dossier for them (eu-05) is needed, since duchy-of-athens ends in 1311.
Page budget exceeded for the two small taifas: taifa-of-cordoba opened 8 pages (the first returned only the 1031-1091 republic) and taifa-of-tejada 4, against budgets of 1-2.
The sources total of 26 counts per-dossier lists; 23 distinct Wikipedia pages were fetched (Taifa, Almohad Caliphate and Almoravid dynasty are cited by both small dossiers).
The Crown dossier ends in 1515 (last Cliopatria shape) with a dissolve into kingdom-of-spain, though the Crown lasted until the Nueva Planta decrees; the ruler strip is omitted.
